newsitem.title: USA: Harvey expects to return to profitability.
newsitem.headline: Harvey expects to return to profitability.

text.p: Harvey Entertainment Co said it expects to return to profitability in the 1997 second quarter due to its agreement with Seagram Co Ltd's Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment to produce the motion picture sequel to "Casper."

Harvey also said it expects profitable operations in the third and fourth quarters as a result of the upcoming release of its first-ever direct-to-video feature, "Casper, A Spirited Beginning," to be distributed by News Corp Ltd affiliate Twentieth Century-Fox Home Entertainment.
